title: Bias-Corrected Estimators for Joint Entropy, Conditional Entropy, and Mutual Information in the Discrete Bivariate Case: Theory and an Application to Motor Insurance
summary: This paper studies the finite-sample bias of plug-in estimators for joint entropy, conditional entropy, and mutual information for finitely supported discrete random variables. Using the univariate reduction framework developed in our companion works, we derive explicit first-order bias formulas. For a pair (X,Y) with support sizes r and s, the biases are respectively -(rs-1)/(2n), -r(s-1)/(2n), and (r-1)(s-1)/(2n).
